exceptions.rationale: B19 disabled SQLx defaults and explicitly retained only Tokio/Rustls, Postgres, migrate, macros, Chrono and JSON. Cargo still locks rsa through sqlx-mysql because retained sqlx-macros-core package metadata declares the optional MySQL driver; cargo tree proves rsa has no active current-target path. Removing the derive/migration macro stack would require a broad manual row-decoding and migration-runner rewrite, while RustSec reports no patched rsa release. Do not enable SQLx MySQL/any; remove this exception when SQLx stops locking the unused driver, rsa ships a patch, or the macro stack is deliberately replaced, and re-review immediately if the package becomes reachable.

braces has no patched release (all versions affected). It is reachable only through @tailwindcss/cli -> @parcel/watcher -> micromatch, which runs for `tailwindcss --watch` on developer machines. The production CSS build and the shipped app never evaluate untrusted glob patterns, so the stack-exhaustion DoS has no attacker-controlled input. Remove when braces ships a fix or Tailwind drops the dependency; re-review if braces becomes reachable from shipped code.
